investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Helwave Market (online retail); Platform: AWS us-east-1 (zones us-east-1a/us-east-1b/us-east-1c/us-east-1d/us-east-1f); network range 10.3.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster helwav-prod-useast (EKS); Database: postgres server cart-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-d069fed7fcdbf6687; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
